name: Battisti
beschreibung:
History

The website battistis.at names the house Appartementhaus Battisti at Alte Arlbergstraße 3, 6580 St. Anton am Arlberg, email info@battistis.at, telephone +43 670 4091500. It writes that the apartments were fully renovated in 2014. A history before this renovation or a year of construction of the house is not on the page retrieved. On the ground floor is the sports-goods rental Ski West. Three apartments are offered: number 01 and number 02 of 43 square metres each for 2 to 4 people and with a separate sleeping area, number 03 of 30 square metres for 2 people, renovated in 2014 with a great deal of attention to detail.

Getting there

The house describes the location as the heart of St. Anton, two minutes on foot from the pedestrian zone with shops, restaurants and entertainment, and near the Rendlbahn and the Galzigbahn. A parking space is provided. Wi-Fi is available. A bus line or a railway station is not named on the page. The address Alte Arlbergstraße 3 is the published meeting point.

Tips

Each apartment has a fully equipped kitchen with dishwasher, microwave and refrigerator as well as a bathroom with shower and WC and toiletries. All rooms are non-smoking; smoking is allowed outside. The page expressly also names the stay for winter and the proximity to the cable cars, without fixing a piste length or a ski-pass price. Prices, check-in times and a local tax are not on the homepage retrieved. The texts of the page are published in English. An older German sentence that names only the Galzigbahn and a small kitchenette is therefore incomplete: there are three apartments, and the kitchen is described as fully equipped; the Rendlbahn is also nearby.
kurzbeschreibung: Appartementhaus Battisti, Alte Arlbergstraße 3 in St. Anton am Arlberg, renovated in 2014, near the Rendlbahn and the Galzigbahn, with three apartments and Ski West in the house.
